Deere & Company recently announced plans to expand its U.S. footprint by opening a new parts distribution center near Hebron, Indiana, and a cutting-edge excavator factory in Kernersville, North Carolina, both expected to begin operations next year and create roughly 300 jobs in total. Trimble (NasdaqGS:TRMB) named West Side Tractor Sales Co. a new Trimble Technology Outlet and authorized reseller. The partnership expands access to Trimble grade control and positioning systems for John Deere equipment users in northern Illinois, Indiana, and select Michigan counties. West Side Tractor Sales Co. will provide sales, installation, training, and support for Trimble construction technology solutions. articles.title: Deere calls back nearly 100 laid-off Iowa employees after Trump visit
articles.mainIdea: Deere calls back nearly 100 laid-off Iowa employees after Trump visit
articles.summary: The Des Moines Register: Deere calls back nearly 100 laid-off Iowa employees after Trump visit. A day after winning praise from President Donald Trump, John Deere announced it is calling nearly 100 employees back to Iowa plants.
